# Copilot evaluation — in-browser version (generated by `frontend/scripts/eval_copilot.ts`)

Same 26 in-scope + 4 out-of-scope questions and metric definitions as `scripts/eval_copilot.py`, run on the code and models the static demo ships: transformers.js (ONNX Runtime), Xenova/bge-small-en-v1.5 + Xenova/ms-marco-MiniLM-L-6-v2, dtype q8. Answer mode: **template**.

## Retrieval (in-scope questions)

| Retriever | hit@1 | hit@3 | hit@5 | MRR@10 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| dense | 81% | 88% | 96% | 0.849 |
| bm25 | 85% | 96% | 100% | 0.913 |
| hybrid | 81% | 92% | 96% | 0.874 |
| hybrid+rerank | 100% | 100% | 100% | 1.000 |

## Answers

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| In-scope questions answered (not refused) | 100% |
| Out-of-scope questions refused | 100% |
| Gold key fact present in the cited passages | 100% |
| Gold key fact present in the answer text | 69% |
| Answers whose citation markers point to retrieved passages | 100% |
| Answer sentences supported by cited passages (≥80% content-word overlap) | 100% |

Refusal rule: top reranker logit < 0. Lowest in-scope top logit: 1.98; highest out-of-scope: -9.68.
